repeat_interpretation: Three new samplings under identical settings (Python/selector seed 42; server seed not explicitly passed), not distinct-seed experiments. Earlier 10-case pilot is excluded.
compression: Per-case 1-output_n/source_n; arithmetic mean among valid cases within each wave; then equal-weight mean and sample std across exactly three wave means.
compression_failed_cases: null, excluded from that wave's compression mean; valid n reported separately for all three waves
compression_zero_valid_wave: Three-wave compression mean/std remain null; do not skip the wave.
formal_gate: All three waves each have exactly 480 unique terminal baseline cells; all historical token-cap and settled-usage checks pass.
historical_sa: Fixed original 240 model/case rows; one reference run only, with no repeat standard deviation.
raw_results: Read-only; all discovered final records, including failures, are retained as metric/usage snapshots with source SHA256 in aggregate_summary.json.
